summary: Iteration 12 — frontend only. Validated the new global accessibility 'Taille du texte' feature (TopBar + Detail + Settings) end-to-end, plus revalidated two legacy features not previously covered: chapter_size/button_size editor round-trip persistence, and the end-of-chapter engagement block in ChapterReader (reader-comment / reader-share). All 16 UI/integration assertions passed with no console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: TextSizeButton menu close on click-outside uses mousedown; touch users on iOS may need a touch handler too (works today via synthesized mouse events but worth noting).
Detail.js renders TextSizeButton with borderRadius from --radius-base but omits the shared border in the same way as siblings — visually consistent; no action needed.
Settings.js is now ~475 lines and still growing (Accessibility, Intro, Ambience, Categories all in one file) — recommended to split into separate manager files for maintainability.
test_credentials: Admin PIN 1234 via localStorage sx_admin=1 + sx_pin=1234. Intro bypass: sx_intro_off=1 + sessionStorage sx_intro_shown=1.
seed_data_creation: None. Reused existing 'Born X Burn' (chapters, not coming_soon) for regression tests; button_size/chapter_size were toggled to 'xl' as part of the persistence test (main agent may want to reset to previous value).
context_for_next_testing_agent: TextSizeButton mounted in TopBar (Accueil) and Detail action bar. Default textscale='grand' when localStorage.sx_textscale is missing. Root font-size at scales: normal=16, grand=18, xl=20, max=22.4. LocalStorage key 'sx_textscale' persists selection across reload. Settings section 'Accessibilité' (data-testid=text-scale-grid) is available to visitors even without admin. Posters use .sx-poster with width divided by --text-scale, so no mobile horizontal overflow at max scale (verified sw==iw==390). Editor selects editor-button-size/editor-chapter-size round-trip through PUT /api/creations/{id}. Reader engagement block (reader-engagement with reader-comment + reader-share) renders before reader-prev/reader-next in the article, verified via DOM position. reader-comment closes reader and scrolls to comments-section.
